title: Prime ideals of Noetherian rings have finite height
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $\mathfrak p\subset A$ be a prime ideal. Its height, defined as the supremum of lengths of finite strict chains of prime ideals ending at $\mathfrak p$, is a finite natural number.
